title: Mountain bike sabotage after Senate briefing

tellings.quote: About 3 weeks later, someone sawed through the bolt that holds my mountain bike seat on

plain: About three weeks after he briefed people in the US Senate in 2023, someone sawed through the bolt that holds the seat on his mountain bike. That is the account of Steven Greer, a guest who argues on the show that UFO secrets are held by a small global group, and he tells it as something that happened to him. He offers it as a sign that someone wanted to harm or frighten him for speaking out.
